response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS baseline_avg FROM status_averages), qualifying AS (SELECT s.status, s.avg_modelconf, b.baseline_avg FROM status_averages s CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE s.avg_modelconf > b.baseline_avg), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS qualifying_avg FROM qualifying) SELECT q.status, q.avg_modelconf, q.avg_modelconf - q.baseline_avg AS above_baseline, q.avg_modelconf / m.qualifying_avg AS relative_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying q CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean m WHERE q.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.qualifying_avg IS NOT NULL
